requirement: Previously unlaunched PR02 actual truthful native viewer world controls after retained property repair
prerequisite: All five current-source diagnostic viewers built under pr02-controls-current-builds; each actual executable and build-receipt hash checked before launch

configuration.trace: read-only post-Step world flags/events/counters/completion; not benchmark mode; cadence is diagnostic only

controls: P pause and stable completed step
period advances exactly one step while paused
Sleep/Warm Starting/Continuous checkboxes off then on and exact public world getters
combined mapped CPU flags agree with context and GPU flags
restart new world lifetime while paused with controls preserved
actual Profile/Counters/Frame Time tabs and truthful backend labels
Ctrl+Q clean quit and upstream-supported saved rendering settings
input: Reuse already retained pure host held-input proof after source audit. Explicitly focus actual Box3D viewer window; hold mouse270ms after motion120ms; key120ms. Choose coordinates only from actual current screenshots. Adaptive action order allowed within fixed actions/screenshots; no retries/replacements.
acceptance: Each app passes all named behaviors with numeric observer evidence and reviewed actual visible controls/tab content. Upstream Save excludes physics controls; no unsupported persistence requirement. World getters match displayed/context flags once input is consumed; paused step stable, single-step delta exactly1, restart lifetime changes. Original physical tolerances unchanged; this is limited control-contract acceptance, not full dynamics, sample-wide UI/raycast or performance qualification.
stop_rule: Stop first infrastructure, stimulus, source/provenance or control-contract failure or watchdog. Retain failed and passing evidence, leave remaining apps unlaunched. Do not rerun older closed campaigns.
publication: Portable commands/environments, action/state JSON, observer raw data, screenshots, build proof and capture hashes. Full diagnostic clips retained locally; screenshots cover accepted interactions. No headline performance claim.

source_audit_amendment_before_any_app.reason: Box3D SampleContext::Save persists rendering options and sample selection only, excluding enableSleep, enableWarmStarting, enableContinuous, hertz and substeps. Initial protocol assumed physics-setting persistence; remove invented requirement before first app, preserve original bytes. No original physical limits changed, no trial repeated.
